loader_review.behavior: Each tensor goes into its named layer slot. Layer 0 is skipped. Only inclusive configured layers 4..44 receive direction/scale entries. Distinct-layer tensors are not summed together. Project mode normalizes each slot and preserves its norm as strength.

kernel_review.behavior: Uses dir + layer*n and s[layer]; one block per token and residual stream; computes h - s*(h dot v)*v. At configured unit scale, this removes the component along the unit vector.
